note: Source catalogue for the data registry (R-DATA-01, R-DATA-04). Every source records its licence, and `redistribution` records whether that licence permits embedding the value in a shipped bundle, with the basis for that reading. A licence that says NC or ND cannot be declared permitted - scripts/lib/registry.mjs rejects it. The seven entries carried over from assets/data/provenance.json are the sources the site already cites. bls_oews was added in P2.2 when the electrician wage was cited, and no source was invented to fill a row: a source enters this file when a value actually cites it.

nasa_power.publisher: NASA POWER Project, Langley Research Center
nasa_power.title: POWER Hourly API - solar irradiance and ambient temperature
nasa_power.basis: A US Government work in the public domain: redistribution needs no permission and no attribution obligation beyond the citation we give anyway.

eia_retail.title: Electric Power Monthly - retail electricity prices
eia_retail.basis: Verified at EIA's own terms page on 2026-11-05, which says in its first line that 'U.S. government publications are in the public domain and are not subject to copyright protection' and that you may 'use and/or distribute any of our data, files, databases, reports, graphs, charts'. It asks for an acknowledgment naming the publication date, which the value's note carries.

lbnl_tracking_the_sun.publisher: Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory - Energy Markets and Planning
lbnl_tracking_the_sun.title: U.S. Distributed Solar and Storage: 2025 Data Update (Tracking the Sun)
lbnl_tracking_the_sun.license: LBNL/UC report; the project-level data are published for public use
lbnl_tracking_the_sun.basis: The value embedded is a single summary statistic - the 20th percentile, median and 80th percentile installed price in dollars per watt - which is a fact, not the report's expression, so reproducing it with its edition cited is not reproducing the work. Berkeley Lab also publishes the underlying project-level data as a public data file described as non-confidential and non-proprietary, which is the source a visitor can check these percentiles against. The deck's copyright notice reserves rights in the manuscript for the Regents and grants the US Government rights in it; no chart, table layout or passage is copied into the site. If a later reader disagrees about the statistic, the fallback is link_only, which costs the visitor an embedded number but not the citation.

bls_oews.title: Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) - Electricians, 47-2111
bls_oews.basis: Verified at BLS's own copyright page on 2026-11-05: BLS is a Federal agency and 'everything that we publish, both in hard copy and electronically, is in the public domain, except for previously copyrighted photographs and illustrations. You are free to use our public domain material without specific permission, although we do ask that you cite the Bureau of Labor Statistics as the source.' The value's note cites BLS, as asked. The registered emblem is a trademark and is not used.

iso_4217.title: ISO 4217 currency codes
iso_4217.basis: A currency code string is a fact carrying no copyrightable expression; the standard's prose is not redistributed, only the three-letter code.

iso_3166.title: ISO 3166 country codes
iso_3166.basis: A country code string is a fact carrying no copyrightable expression; the site already ships these codes as its place-file names.

nrel_degradation.title: Photovoltaic Degradation Rate Study
nrel_degradation.basis: A US Government work in the public domain.

open_er_api_fx.title: Exchange rate API
open_er_api_fx.license: Free tier, terms at the linked site
open_er_api_fx.basis: Free-tier terms live at the vendor's site and are not recorded in this repo, so a redistribution right is not established here. The runtime refresh contract is P2.5's to pin with the terms in hand; until then an FX figure is linked, never embedded.

fraunhofer_pv.title: Photovoltaics Report
fraunhofer_pv.basis: "Freely downloadable" is a reading permission, not a redistribution licence. Values taken from the report are linked for the visitor to check rather than embedded.
